description: Details of an existing booking: status, route, pickup time, price, payment, driver information once assigned, and the manage-booking URL. Identity is the booking reference plus the email address used on the booking (the same login as the website manage-booking page); the API rejects a mismatch. The booking reference is the numeric reservation ID from the confirmation email; the same number in APL-<id> form also works.

booking_ref.description: Booking reference — the numeric reservation ID shown on the confirmation email and the manage-booking page (e.g. "1013869"), or the same number in "APL-<id>" form (e.g. "APL-1013869"). Both formats accepted.

email.description: Passenger email on the booking — required, must match exactly

name: lookup_booking
title: Look Up Booking
